title: Wonderful Everyday: The Hill of Sunflowers
alt: Two schoolgirls go up a path through a hill of sunflowers, hand in hand, with their backs to us. The girl on the left has brown hair tied up with a yellow ribbon, holds a white rabbit doll, and looks back with a laugh. The girl on the right is taller, and the wind carries her long dark hair out to the right. The sky is deep blue, with tall white clouds and the trail of an aeroplane. Yellow petals fly in the wind.
summary: A painting of the hill of sunflowers from Wonderful Everyday in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the hill of sunflowers, from Wonderful Everyday (Subarashiki Hibi), a visual novel by KeroQ. Most of the story is dark. One of its ends comes back to this hill in the country, in summer.

Hasaki is on the left, with her rabbit doll. She looks back at us. Yuki is on the right. The story speaks of the sky again and again, and of how to live happily. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
